description: Set the current arm profile to be used when enabling the arm alarm. Only available when using local alarm manager.

local.python:
import http.client
import json


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = json.dumps({
  "armProfileId": "string"
})
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
conn.request("PATCH", "/proxy/protect/integration/v1/arm-profiles/settings", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Set current arm profile
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/arm-profiles/settings"
    method: PATCH
    body:
      armProfileId: string
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
